description: Maracas Waterfalls, situated in St. Joseph Valley, is stunningly beautiful and Trinidad's highest waterfall with an altitude of 91.5 meters. The scenery offers breathtaking natural beauty. It is accessed via Waterfall Road in Maracas Valley in St. Joseph. Listed opening hours: 6:00AM - 6:00PM Daily. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
